name: 2 shaga do...
source:
You wake up on a bus at the gates of Camp "Sovenok"... Your cherished dream has finally come true. At last, the moment you’ve been waiting for! Go on - embrace the joy ahead.

But something isn’t right. Things aren’t unfolding the way you imagined. Your personal paradise is falling apart before your eyes.

You must uncover the truth behind what's happening. And, inevitably, you’ll have to make choices. Be careful - a single mistake could come at a high cost. Don’t stumble.

This is a story about human emotions and flaws - egoism and selflessness, cowardice and courage, despair and hope, belief and doubt. And in the end: love… and hate? Or perhaps something worse - indifference.

You’ll have to face it all. And in the end, it’s up to you to decide - will you become Human?
